content: Hi! This is Payroll Support. How can I assist you with your recent salary deposit or direct deposit setup today?
I just wanted to check if my paycheck for July was sent to my new bank. I updated my account last month.
Let me confirm for you: payroll for July was transferred on July 1st to account ending in 6621 via ACH, per your update. The amount deposited was $2,485.37. Does this match your expectations?
Yes, that's correct. My Chase checking ends in 6621. Can you check if there's any delay? I haven't seen the funds yet.

According to our records, the ACH transaction ID 87452392 was processed at 8:03 AM on July 1st. Typically, these clear within one business day, so it should be visible in your account by this afternoon at the latest.
Thanks. My employee ID is 12786, just in case you need to double-check.

Thank you, 12786 is the correct employee ID for Emily Dawson at dawson.e@brightcorp.com. No further verification needed, but if it's not received by 5 PM, please let us know immediately for escalation.
Alright, will do. Is there a reference I should mention if I have to call back?
Yes, please reference payroll batch 20230701-B and your transaction ID 87452392 for faster follow-up. This will help us resolve any urgent issues right away.
